merchant/30001.htm.text: Trader Lector: Can I give you some advice? Just because something is expensive doesn't mean that it's necessary the best option. A child cannot handle a two-handed sword, right? Be sure to pick equipment that's appropriate for your profession and experience level.

links.text: View information about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30001-1.htm.text: Trader Lector: What would you like to trade?

merchant/30001-pk.htm.text: Trader Lector: I have nothing to sell to a scoundrel like you! Get out of my sight, or I'll give you a taste of my fist.

Q00258_BringWolfPelts/30001-02.htm.text: Trader Lector: I may be a merchant now, but I used to be a Leather Cutter. I used to work for Duke Van Dyke in my early days. During the Elmore War, I made hundreds of leather armors for the Duke's soldiers in ten days. Even after retiring, I still practice making leather armor from time to time to…

Q00258_BringWolfPelts/30001-01.html.text: Trader Lector: I am a trader now, but I used to be a leather craftsman. Even now, I buy materials every now and then to make leather clothing, gloves, cloaks, and boots. May I ask you later to find me materials if I need them? (Quest for characters level 3 and above.)

Q00258_BringWolfPelts/30001-04.html.text: Trader Lector: So you haven't gotten all of the Wolf Pelts yet. I know it is difficult, but please gather forty pelts and bring them back to me. In return, I will give you a piece of equipment that will be quite useful to you.

Q00258_BringWolfPelts/30001-05.html.text: Trader Lector: Oh, I see you've brought me forty Wolf Pelts. Well done! As promised, I will give you a defense armor that will be useful to you. It has been made by the Dwarven craftsmen of Giran, and is guaranteed to be of the highest quality.

Q00258_BringWolfPelts/30001-03.html.text: Trader Lector: Hunt wolves and bring me their pelts. Bring me forty of the pelts and, in return, I will give you a piece of equipment that is useful to you. There is little time left if I am to finish the fifty leather armors that the governor has ordered by this week. So please hurry.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
